race.comment: DR FARTHING (16) chased gamely into fifth when resuming at Eagle Farm three weeks ago. Is drawn sticky again but gets a key booking in Thompson and has won here before. With a touch of luck from out there, he'll be in the finish. HOWDOYOUZOU (10) has returned in great order and should spear across to race handy. At his top now fourth-up and will give them something to catch. ANGEL LADDER (5) was too bad to be true first-up when failing as favourite. Can forgive on what she produced last campaign. YOWERI (7) was a good winner last start and drawn to be prominent again. Has to be included.
